title: Callisia Repens Rosato - 1x Mini Plug - Pink Turtle Vine - Easy Care Houseplant
description:
Bring a pop of pink to your plant collection with this charming mini plug of Callisia repens ‘Rosato’ (also known as Pink Panther/Turtle Vine). This compact, trailing houseplant features tiny variegated leaves with beautiful shades of pastel pink, cream, and green. Perfect for small pots, terrariums, mixed planters, or as a cute shelf accent.


 What you’ll receive:


  Quantity: 1x mini plug plant
 

  Size: Young rooted plug (approx. 2–4 cm plant top, plug cell 2–3 cm)
 

  Supplied in: Grower’s plug, not a decorative pot
 

  Plant type: Callisia repens ‘Rosato’ (live plant)
 

 Plant features:


  Dainty trailing growth habit
 

  Attractive pink variegation
 

  Fast grower in the right conditions
 

  Great for beginners and collectors
 

 Care guide:


  Light: Bright, indirect light for best pink colour. Avoid harsh midday sun.
 

  Water: Keep lightly moist; allow the top 1–2 cm of media to dry between waterings. Do not let sit in water.
 

  Humidity: Average home humidity is fine; enjoys 40–60%.
 

  Temperature: 15–26°C. Protect from cold drafts.
 

  Soil: Well-draining mix (houseplant or aroid mix with added perlite).
 

  Feed: Light feeder during spring–summer (half-strength every 4–6 weeks).
 

 Growth and appearance:


  Expect some natural variation in leaf color and pattern.
 

  As a young plug, it will establish and fill out over the coming weeks with proper care.
 

  Can be lightly trimmed to encourage fuller, bushier growth.
 

 Shipping and packaging:


  Carefully packed to protect the plug during transit.
 

  Sent bare plug or in its grow plug with minimal media to reduce damage and mess.
 

  Some minor leaf curl or cosmetic blemishes may occur in transit; this is normal and the plant will recover with proper care.
 

 Important notes:


  Live plant: No returns on perishables, but please contact us within 48 hours of delivery with clear photos if there are any issues.
 

  Not for consumption. Keep out of reach of pets and children.
 

 Ideal for:


  Windowsills, shelves, desktops
 

  Hanging planters and small trailing displays
 

  Terrariums (with regular trimming)
 

  Plant gifts and starter collections
